### Library loading

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Data retrival

First, we created a local directory to store the data in. For reproducibility, the dataset was then programmatically retrieved directly from the hbiostat online repository. Lastly, the data was loaded into the R environment.
To avoid overwriting the directory or file every time the code is run, we included if-statements to check whether the directory or file already exist. This way, the directory is only created and the file is only downloaded if they don't already exist.

```{r}
raw_dir <- "../data/_raw/"
data_file <- "prostate.rda"
data_loc <- "https://hbiostat.org/data/repo/"

if (!dir.exists(raw_dir)) {
  dir.create(
    path = raw_dir,
    recursive = TRUE
    )
}

if (!file.exists(str_c(raw_dir, data_file))) {
  download.file(
    url = str_c(data_loc, data_file),
    destfile = str_c(raw_dir, data_file)
    )
}

load(file = str_c(raw_dir, data_file))

```

### Data conversion

For transparency and accessibility outside of R, the data was converted into a csv-file.

```{r}
data_dir <- "../data/"
data_conv <- "01_prostate.csv"

write_csv(
  x = prostate,
  file = str_c(data_dir, data_conv)
  )
```
